checks: Preparation forms are guarded by approved project archive
Form workspace enforces project and tenant scope
Structured preparation roster distinguishes roles and detects stale edits
Form generation requires reviewed content, valid person count and matching package/preparation/person versions
Four actual DOCX form kinds start unsigned and generation retries do not duplicate forms
Generated forms use restricted immutable files, real DOCX bytes and matching hashes
Signature return requires restricted signed-file category, actual date, unique roster people and manual attestation
Return registration links the exact source form and file hash without marking the whole roster signed
Personnel edits make old print snapshots stale and require an explicit explanation for old-paper returns
Next form version preserves original bytes and does not inherit old signature associations
Voiding an incorrect return preserves its original bytes and allows a traceable corrected association
Voided forms reject new returns while historical form and signature downloads remain available
File creator and general confidential-file privilege cannot bypass the personnel confidentiality permission
Authorized read-only staff may inspect and download but cannot alter the roster
mode: real HTTP + PostgreSQL + Flowable + MinIO + generated DOCX; synthetic signature evidence only
